notes.title: [Major Update] Additional character growth and new route choices
notes.content: [p][b]Preparing for the official release, I optimized a ton of content![/b][/p][h2]New character illustrations[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/de5ea29e39e5d15081e19b0721bbc26140a3cbe4.png"][/img][/p][h2]New system:[/h2][p]After completing a mission, your level can be converted into experience points[/p][p]Experience points can be used to enhance your character's attributes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/455965f8bfc81aa2cd49648d6d558caf14a7402b.png"][/img][/p][p]Weapon selection, synthesis, and weapon chest rewards,[/p][p]Multiple artifact selections and upgrades[/p][p]Artifact upgrades provide even more powerful effects![/p][h2]New route selection:[/h2][p]You can now challenge the Slime King![/p][p]Defeat each wave of enemies until you face the Slime King.[/p][h2]other:[/h2][p]Optimized enemy targeting[/p][p]Optimized player character controls[/p]

notes.title: EA Ver0.3 update
notes.content:
-> New content, adding more skills.
Echo of Life: Triggers an shockwave after HP changes 10 times, damage affected by defense.
Supply Crate: At the start of battle, periodically generates a crate near the player.
Energy Shield: Creates a protective shield that blocks multiple attacks before entering cooldown.
Frugal: Gain coins after defeating enemies.
Aftermath: Receive healing when losing coins, with a 3s cooldown.
Cicada Sheds Its Shell: Extends invincibility time after taking damage.
Finger Snap: Periodically deals 0 damage to self.

-> Adjusted the aggression of the Stone Golem boss.

-> Optimized the excessive attack hitboxes of Slime minions.

-> Added an achievement system.

*Still unsure how to handle the extra-progression system.

I will continue to update the content.

notes.title: Game operation guidance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/7941a2ff39fd3dfd18b7541f8a7e07d9d83701fb.gif[/img]
Here, I will briefly introduce the operation mode of the game.

*There is a terminal in the base that can unlock weapons and skills.

Keyboard and mouse operation:

Your mouse can aim in the right direction

Left click, left hand weapon
Right click on the right-hand weapon

W. S, A, D - direction of movement

F - Interaction

Space - Jump

C or I - backpack

V - Map

R - Use potion


Controller operation (Xbox controller as an example):

The right joystick can control the mouse and aim

Left joystick controls movement

B interaction

Y backpack

LB Jump

RB map

Use potion under the cross key

Menu button opens the map

X Left Hand Weapon

A right-handed weapon

notes.title: 《Rogue hand》now released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, my game is set to release on March 9th.

The game will receive continuous updates.
After release, the focus will mainly be on fixing bugs and developing new content.
Currently, we are working on out-of-game progression.

[b]A basic guide.[/b]
[b]Survival is key! Defense is crucial.[/b]

Combine the effects of Rage and Relics. Accumulating hits taken and then releasing a shockwave is an excellent choice, as it can deal massive AoE damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/ccc546212aa0ddb14209bd9326dd856187bb82c2.png[/img]

[b]When health is full, use the Master's Ring![/b]
When health is full, each attack will release a shockwave! The condition is a bit strict, but if we choose abilities that reduce maximum health, this relic becomes easier to trigger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/4990e910c5d2c2466af972353a8d7e921896f62b.gif[/img]

[b]Healing Pendant[/b]
Restores health periodically, a great survival relic!

Weapon Choices:
Each weapon has its own progression path.
Combining multiple attributes can be even more effective.
Upcoming update plans:

Out-of-game progression content
After release, aside from bug fixes.New content will be added.
